name: IconText

accessibility:
- **ARIA labels:** Always set an `ariaLabel` for icons for screen readers.
- **Order:** The icon is visually before the text by default.
- **Keyboard:** If used in a button or link, keyboard accessibility is handled by the parent.

:::info
For star ratings or icon lists, use `items` with `iconProps` and optional `text`.
:::
summary: The `IconText` component provides a Bulma-styled horizontal arrangement of one or more `Icon` components and optional text.

parts.summary: The `IconText` component provides a Bulma-styled horizontal arrangement of one or more `Icon` components and optional text.

props.name: color
props.description: Text color alias: renders `has-text-<color>`, exactly like `textColor`. Not a filled variant (no `.icon-text.is-<color>` CSS exists). Prefer `textColor`, which takes precedence when both are set; use `bgColor` for a colored surface.

props.name: iconProps
props.description: Props for a single Icon component (for single icon mode).

props.name: children
props.description: Text for a single icon (for single icon mode).

props.name: items
props.description: Array of icon/text pairs (for multiple icons mode).

parts.catchAll: All standard <span> attributes and Bulma helper props

parts.summary: The `Icon` component is a Bulma-styled wrapper for displaying icons from various libraries (Font Awesome, Material Design Icons, Ionicons, Google Material Icons, Material Symbols, etc.).

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color modifier for the icon.

props.name: name
props.description: The icon name, with or without its library prefix (e.g. `'star'` or `'fa-star'`).

props.name: library
props.description: The icon library to use ('fa' = Font Awesome, 'mdi' = Material Design Icons, 'ion' = Ionicons Web Components, 'material-icons' = Google Material Icons, 'material-symbols' = Google Material Symbols). Defaults to the value set in ConfigProvider or 'fa' if not configured.

props.name: size
props.description: Size modifier for the icon container.

parts.catchAll: All standard <span> attributes and Bulma helper props
